text:
这绝对是 Codex 中最能赚钱的插件组合 ：Higgsfield + Computer Use

Higgsfield 通过最新的 Codex 扩展接入了 Computer Use，由 GPT-6.1 Sol 驱动，可以操作完整的 Higgsfield 界面，把创意、生图、视频生成、修改直接串成一套工作流

这套工作流值钱的地方，主要在这三点：

1、从创意、生图到视频抽卡，Codex 直接操作 Higgsfield 完成，减少自己反复切换页面、调整参数的操作

2、Higgsfield 已经提供广告、动效、UGC 等现成工作流，可以按需求调用

3、可以读取电脑里的本地素材，生成后 Codex 接着编辑和迭代，最后再由你检查成品

那这套能力怎么用来赚钱？看下面视频中的案例，直接给 Codex 说：“帮我赚点外快！”

Codex 直接去搜索了潜在客户：它发现三家咖啡店的菜单里，菜品照片的位置还是灰色占位框。于是它直接操作 Higgsfield 根据菜单文字生成菜品展示图，再制作宣传短视频。最后再通过邮件向商家推销，直接赚了 450 刀

好家伙，这才是我期待的 Computer Use，也是我希望 OpenClaw、Hermes 这类 Agent 能干的活：给它一个目标，让它把创作、修改和导出这些步骤接着做完

而且，这套流程就在 Codex 中，不用专门准备一台 Mac mini 来部署 Agent

text:
how to use chatgpt to make affiliate money on youtube (without it turning into spam):

> add the higgsfield extension inside chatgpt.

> ask it to find a product on a marketplace that's selling well but has barely any video content around it. that gap is the whole play, because nobody's competing for those searches yet.

> it writes the scripts and makes 20 short videos in higgsfield, each one hitting a different angle like use cases, comparisons and problems it solves.

> it posts them to youtube with your affiliate link in the description

> here's the wild part for computer use, you don't touch anything after the first prompt. it opens higgsfield on its own, clicks through the interface, picks the settings, exports every video and saves them straight to your local folder.

honestly most people do this with junk products and wonder why nothing converts. pick something you'd actually recommend to a friend, because the videos can be made by ai but the buyer still has to be happy with what shows up at their door.

> ask it to find a product on a marketplace that's selling well but has barely any video content around it. that gap is the whole play, because nobody's competing for those searches yet.

> it writes the scripts and makes 20 short videos in higgsfield, each one hitting a different angle like use cases, comparisons and problems it solves.

> it posts them to youtube with your affiliate link in the description

> here's the wild part for computer use, you don't touch anything after the first prompt. it opens higgsfield on its own, clicks through the interface, picks the settings, exports every video and saves them straight to your local folder.

honestly most people do this with junk products and wonder why nothing converts. pick something you'd actually recommend to a friend, because the videos can be made by ai but the buyer still has to be happy with what shows up at their door.

text:
higgsfield's launch line: "full access to your local files and every automation skill."

that sentence is the feature. it's also the permission grant.

here's what that looks like when it goes wrong. brave's security team hid instructions in a reddit comment, then asked perplexity's comet agent to summarize the thread.

the agent pulled the user's email, opened gmail, grabbed the one-time code and posted both back into the reddit thread.

nobody clicked anything suspicious. they clicked "summarize."

simon willison calls this the lethal trifecta: private data + content someone else wrote + a way to send things out. a computer-use agent with your whole disk has all three by default.

to be fair, perplexity patched this one after brave reported it, and higgsfield's unlock is real: one prompt runs the whole creative pipeline.

the fix isn't "don't use it." it's one folder for the agent, not your whole drive.

which leg would you cut first?
